description: Reusable Copilot prompt templates for the Sudoku project.

prompts.name: unique-solution-generator
prompts.template: In starter/sudoku_logic.py, review {function}. Preserve the 9x9 integer-list board representation where 0 means empty. Add a bounded solution counter that stops after two solutions, reject clue removals unless exactly one solution remains, and propose a focused unittest for unique, ambiguous, and unsolvable fixtures.

prompts.name: accessible-ui-review
prompts.template: Review starter/templates/index.html, starter/static/main.js, and starter/static/styles.css for WCAG 2.1 AA issues. Check keyboard access, focus visibility, labels, live status messages, contrast, and responsive layout. Return only concrete findings and small fixes.

prompts.name: api-error-hardening
prompts.template: In starter/app.py, audit {route} for malformed JSON, invalid dimensions, wrong types, and out-of-range values. Keep routes small, use consistent {"error": "message"} JSON responses, and add a regression test for each failure case.

prompts.name: focused-change-review
prompts.template: Make the smallest change needed for {behavior}. First state the current limitation, then implement it within the existing module boundary, and finish with one executable validation command and its expected result.
